reviews.title: Best heavyweight tee in Bangladesh hands down
reviews.comment: The 320 GSM weight is unreal. The isometric 3D logo has real depth and doesn't crack after washing. Definitely fits oversized just like the London / Tokyo streetwear drops.

reviews.title: Crisp ribbed collar that never sags
reviews.comment: Washed it 5 times already and the raw chalk white has not shrunk or yellowed. Stitching on shoulders and hem is immaculate.

reviews.title: Exceptional cut and material
reviews.comment: The water resistance worked great in Dhaka rain. The cinch waistband is super clean and the silhouette stacks over sneakers perfectly.

reviews.title: Best tech pants I own
reviews.comment: The 4-way stretch is incredibly comfortable for daily commutes. The magnetic waistband closure feels futuristic and secure.

reviews.title: Sculptural hood and unmatched density
reviews.comment: No drawstrings makes it look so elevated. The fleece feels like a $300 luxury piece. Truly top-tier production.

reviews.title: Incredible 480 GSM warmth
reviews.comment: Wore this in chilly weather and did not need a jacket. The crossover double-layer hood stands erect on its own.

reviews.title: Matte ripstop shell and 2-way hardware are unreal
reviews.comment: The thermal quilted lining keeps you warm without bulk. The metallic back crest detailing is subtle yet turns heads. Outstanding archive piece.

reviews.title: Superb layering jacket
reviews.comment: Fits effortlessly over the 480 GSM hoodie. The magnetic storm flap pockets are super practical for phone and cards.

reviews.title: Sturdy and fits my 16 inch laptop easily
reviews.comment: The 18oz canvas is heavy duty. Love the isometric print and inside zip pocket.

reviews.title: Heavy duck canvas that doesn't sag
reviews.comment: Reinforced box handles hold heavy groceries or university books without straining. The raw ecru colorway matches every fit.

reviews.title: Mineral stone wash gives that authentic vintage patina
reviews.comment: Looks like a vintage Japanese archive piece. The triangular neck insert and subtle distress around hems give it pure character.

reviews.title: Raw curl hem and extended drawcord look fire
reviews.comment: Super breathable 360 GSM French terry. Sits right above the knee with room on the thighs. Best streetwear summer shorts in Dhaka.

reviews.title: 100% Merino wool with zero itch
reviews.comment: Super soft fisherman rib knit. Keeps head warm and the matte silicone Dimension logo patch on the cuff is sleek.

reviews.title: Japanese selvedge denim is heavyweight perfection
reviews.comment: 14.5oz selvedge denim with hand-distressed collar and custom gunmetal hardware. The boxy dropped shoulders drape cleanly over tees.

reviews.title: Essential streetwear boxy drape
reviews.comment: Blind-stitched hems and clean back-neck branding. 290 GSM combed cotton feels dense and luxurious on body.

reviews.title: Matte 2-way zipper and 480 GSM heft
reviews.comment: Being able to zip up from the bottom allows you to show off inner layers. Split kangaroo pockets and deep cuffs make this my favorite daily wear.

reviews.title: Cobra metal buckle is indestructible
reviews.comment: 1000D Cordura ballistic nylon with waterproof taped seams. Holds wallet, powerbank, sunglasses, and keys with dedicated dividers.

reviews.title: Breezy linen drape with natural cooling
reviews.comment: Camp collar and genuine mother of pearl buttons. Wore this open over a white tank top in 34 degree weather, felt super light.

reviews.title: Double pleats create an incredible silhouette
reviews.comment: Stacks cleanly over chunky sneakers or derbies. Heavy twill fabric that keeps its crease after machine wash.

reviews.title: High density graphic print with vintage acid wash
reviews.comment: Graphic has great texture and hasn't cracked at all. Collar distressing is subtle and well-made.

reviews.title: Super thick terry bottom and arch compression
reviews.comment: Doesn't slide down your calf when walking. The embroidered Dimension tab on the outer ankle looks fire with low tops.
